subject: Banking
title: Embedded Finance Everywhere
description: A micro-lesson that makes Embedded Finance Everywhere usable.

hook.text: Buy a car and get financing from the dealership app. Embedded finance puts banking inside every other product.

buildup.text: Shopify offers loans to merchants. Uber provides debit cards to drivers.

discovery.text: Infrastructure providers like Unit, Treasury Prime, and Bond let any company offer bank accounts and cards via API.

twist.text: Embedded finance could make standalone banks obsolete.

climax.text: Finance is becoming a feature, not a destination. The bank disappears into the platform where you spend your time.

punchline.text: Banking inside every app. Finance becomes a feature, not a separate product.

quiz.question: What is embedded finance?
options: Financial services built into non-financial platforms and apps
